title: The Corvette Grand Sport X delivers Porsche 911 performance for a fraction of the price
summary: The GSX itself replaces the Corvette E-Ray , Chevrolet’s first hybrid sports car. So the GSX’s 721 horsepower represents a 186-hp bump over a Grand Sport or 2027 Stingray.
